title: It was not true that she used to wear kid gloves in bed or take a milk footbath either
html_source: Throughout the romance magazine-style writing, Joyce punctures and provides comic notes. A milk footbath was a genuine act of cosmetic therapy proposed by magazines, and possibly still is.
